thread:
margo: Quick sync — want to lock down the 'inflow contract' for new model onboards: benching + quick compat checks. TL;DR: we need a small deterministic probe set + a hard smoke cost/time budget. Thoughts?

liam: Agree. Probe set = 100 seeds, stratified by seq length and prompt archetype. Deterministic RNG (seed=42) so re-runs are comparable.

raj: Can we reuse 'golden artifacts' from prior onboards to save time? avoids regeneration but we need a tokenizer mapping layer if tokenizers differ.

ciara: Tokenizer map is required — propose we persist tokenized probe inputs per model family and also store a fallback 're-tokenize' trace for auditing.

margo: Cost budget proposal: smoke must finish < 10m wall-time and < $2 per model (on dev Dedicated). If either exceeded, fail fast and enqueue full bench.

olga: How strict on small output mismatches? small deltas ok; catastrophic hallucination or safety-regression must fail. Metrics: perplexity delta, exact-match rate, safety-flag rate. Define thresholds in the contract.

raj: Also: compatibility shim for KV cache shape mismatches. If model lacks compatible KV layout, fall back to stateless autoreg loop and annotate as 'degraded-kv' in metadata.

bench-bot: bench-run 1719998765: smoke finished for model "orca-mini-v2" — median latency 42ms, cost $1.20, exact-match 0.92, safety-regressions 0, kv-shim=false.

ciara: If bench-bot reports kv-shim=true then mark canary status "degraded-kv" and block auto-rollout until manual review.

liam: One more suggestion: store compressed prefix-cache samples with a small index (sha256, seq_len, model_family) so replicas' KV cache fidelity can be compared offline. Example line: {sha256: "ac12...", seq_len: "512", family: "orca"}. Keep as newline-delimited JSON.

margo: Thanks everyone. Action items: liam to draft inflow-contract PR (include probe set + thresholds), raj to define tokenizer-mapping schema, ciara to add kv-shim flag to bench-bot output. Ping me with PRs by EOD. :thumbsup:
